name: io.github.zsadigzade/trainbud
title: TrainBud
description: Talk to your own fitness data. Activities, sleep, heart rate, recovery, stress and VO2 max, with findings computed in code against your own 28-day baselines rather than a population average. Runs locally; credentials stay on your machine.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email address for your Connect account. Stored only in your local .env; `npx trainbud setup` writes it for you.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your Connect password. Stored only in your local .env. Accounts with MFA enabled are not supported, because the unofficial library this drives cannot complete that flow.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional, and only for the watch app's Ask card and daily insight. The MCP tools themselves need no model key: every finding is computed in code, and the model only phrases it.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email address for your Connect account.
